scope: Independent audit of the order-41 omega=5 residual-overlap package; no source implementation edit, CEGAR run, commit, push, publication, or full order-41 claim

binding_policy.rule: This JSON binds the completed audit Markdown and every audited input. The audit Markdown does not contain this JSON's hash, and this JSON intentionally does not contain its own hash.

catalogue_provenance.official_page_wording: All Ramsey(3,6)-graphs; 2576 at order 16 and 7 at order 17
catalogue_provenance.historical_catalogue_citation: S. P. Radziszowski and D. L. Kreher, On (3,k) Ramsey graphs: theoretical and computational results, J. Combin. Math. Combin. Comput. 4 (1988), 37-52

checker_replay.audit_interpretation: Replay succeeds but is not validating: the checker omits seed automorphism orbits and asserts the resulting incorrect counts.

independent_crosscheck.method: Separate short-form graph6 parser, stable-refinement plus exact adjacency backtracking isomorphism enumeration, complete automorphism transport, independent bounded-sum DP, and exhaustive 2^16 subset beta calculation

root_cause.description: A newly created class stores only the seed cross-degree vector. It does not transport that vector through Aut(U), although later records are transported through every VF2 isomorphism.

blockers: Close every seed pattern under the full automorphism group of its common-U representative.
Recompute and emit the corrected T preliminary count 10 and D survivor count 17, including the five omitted D representatives.
Update the proof note and source result JSON, then independently replay and rebind them to the corrected checker.
safe_claim_boundary: The elementary lemmas and the catalogue-conditional exclusion of T survive. R remains open. D remains open and is reduced by the stated necessary conditions to 17, not 12, common cores. No order-41 theorem, SAT/UNSAT result, or solution of Erdos problem 151 is established.
